name: Razor-Back
source:
An unclassified rogue spy soldier. Hired by the doctor's rival company GASNAS, Inc., he manages to get inside the laboratory but is caught and used as a guinea pig for robot testing. Caught in the web of robots and lovers, will his strong body and spirited heart be broken? Find out...

[From [url=https://www.rainbow-shoppers.com/en/www/cdrom_abdiel.html]Rainbow Shoppers[/url]]
